# Euler Problem 208 Solution in Ada

I'll solve this step by step, implementing the solution in Ada.

First, let me understand what the problem is asking:
- A robot moves on a regular polygon with n vertices
- It can turn left or right at each step
- The robot cannot reverse direction (can't go back to previous vertex)
- We need to count the number of ways to return to starting position after exactly 70 steps

## Analysis

This is a dynamic programming problem where we track:
- Current position on the polygon
- Previous direction taken
- Number of steps remaining

Let me implement this solution:

```ada
with Ada.Text_IO; use Ada.Text_IO;

procedure Euler_208 is
   -- Number of vertices in the polygon
   N : constant Integer := 70;
   
   -- Maximum number of steps
   MAX_STEPS : constant Integer := 70;
   
   -- Memoization table for dynamic programming
   type DP_Table is array (1..N, 0..MAX_STEPS, 0..1) of Long_Long_Integer;
   DP : DP_Table := (others => (others => (others => 0)));
   
   -- Function to compute the number of paths
   function Count_Paths(Position : Integer; Steps_Left : Integer; Last_Dir : Integer) return Long_Long_Integer is
      Result : Long_Long_Integer;
   begin
      -- Base case: no steps left
      if Steps_Left = 0 then
         if Position = 1 then
            return 1;
         else
            return 0;
         end if;
      end if;
      
      -- Check memoization table
      if DP(Position, Steps_Left, Last_Dir) /= 0 then
         return DP(Position, Steps_Left, Last_Dir);
      end if;
      
      Result := 0;
      
      -- Try going clockwise (direction 0)
      if Last_Dir /= 1 then  -- Can't reverse direction
         declare
            Next_Pos : constant Integer := 
               if Position = N then 1 else Position + 1;
         begin
            Result := Result + Count_Paths(Next_Pos, Steps_Left - 1, 0);
         end;
      end if;
      
      -- Try going counter-clockwise (direction 1)
      if Last_Dir /= 0 then  -- Can't reverse direction
         declare
            Next_Pos : constant Integer := 
               if Position = 1 then N else Position - 1;
         begin
            Result := Result + Count_Paths(Next_Pos, Steps_Left - 1, 1);
         end;
      end if;
      
      DP(Position, Steps_Left, Last_Dir) := Result;
      return Result;
   end Count_Paths;
   
   -- Main solution function
   function Solve return Long_Long_Integer is
      Total : Long_Long_Integer := 0;
   begin
      -- Start from vertex 1, can go either direction initially
      -- Go clockwise first (direction 0)
      Total := Total + Count_Paths(2, MAX_STEPS - 1, 0);
      
      -- Go counter-clockwise first (direction 1)  
      Total := Total + Count_Paths(N, MAX_STEPS - 1, 1);
      
      return Total;
   end Solve;
   
begin
   Put_Line("Euler Problem 208 Solution:");
   Put_Line("Number of ways to return to starting position after 70 steps:");
   Put_Line(Long_Long_Integer'Image(Solve));
end Euler_208;
```

with Ada.Text_IO; use Ada.Text_IO;

procedure Euler_208 is
   -- Number of vertices in the polygon (70)
   N : constant Integer := 70;
   
   -- Maximum steps
   STEPS : constant Integer := 70;
   
   -- Memoization table: [position][steps_left][last_direction]
   type DP_Table is array (1..N, 0..STEPS, 0..1) of Long_Long_Integer;
   DP : DP_Table := (others => (others => (others => 0)));
   
   -- Function to count paths
   function Count_Paths(Position : Integer; Steps_Left : Integer; Last_Dir : Integer) return Long_Long_Integer is
      Result : Long_Long_Integer := 0;
      Next_Pos : Integer;
   begin
      -- Base case: no steps left
      if Steps_Left = 0 then
         if Position = 1 then
            return 1;
         else
            return 0;
         end if;
      end if;
      
      -- Check memoization
      if DP(Position, Steps_Left, Last_Dir) /= 0 then
         return DP(Position, Steps_Left, Last_Dir);
      end if;
      
      -- Move clockwise (direction 0)
      if Last_Dir /= 1 then  -- Can't reverse direction
         Next_Pos := Position + 1;
         if Next_Pos > N then
            Next_Pos := 1;
         end if;
         Result := Result + Count_Paths(Next_Pos, Steps_Left - 1, 0);
      end if;
      
      -- Move counter-clockwise (direction 1)
      if Last_Dir /= 0 then  -- Can't reverse direction
         Next_Pos := Position - 1;
         if Next_Pos < 1 then
            Next_Pos := N;
         end if;
         Result := Result + Count_Paths(Next_Pos, Steps_Left - 1, 1);
      end if;
      
      DP(Position, Steps_Left, Last_Dir) := Result;
      return Result;
   end Count_Paths;
   
   function Solve return Long_Long_Integer is
      Total : Long_Long_Integer := 0;
   begin
      -- Start at vertex 1 (position 1)
      -- First step can be either direction
      Total := Count_Paths(2, STEPS - 1, 0);     -- Clockwise
      Total := Total + Count_Paths(N, STEPS - 1, 1);  -- Counter-clockwise
      
      return Total;
   end Solve;
   
begin
   Put_Line("Euler Problem 208 Solution:");
   Put_Line("Number of paths returning to start after 70 steps:");
   Put_Line(Long_Long_Integer'Image(Solve));
end Euler_208;
